sheets.title: LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS, SCHEDULES AND DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet with legend, abbreviations, and four detail blocks. Lighting Fixture Schedule shows one fixture type: XL-03 fixture symbol = Lithonia RSX1 LED P3 40K R4, 277V, 110W, pole-mounted, 8 lamps per luminaire, 8 luminaires total. Notes call for NEMA Type V distribution. Details show LED Area Luminaire, Anchor Base Steel/Aluminum Pole (XL-27), Anchor Base Pole Foundation (XL-29), and Luminaire Mounting Arm Details (XL-31). Pole heights: XL-26 (20') per schedule table. Drawn by Evan Welch, reviewed Craig Guth, PE seal Richard H. Huang (Maryland). BFA project number 13135488 appears in NAVFAC drawing number field. Stamp reads 'BOWMAN FOSTER & ASSOCIATES, INC., 6353 CENTER DR., STE. 101, NORFOLK, VA 23502.' Sheet dated 04/22/2021, issued 05/27/2021.

sheets.title: PARKING LOT SITE PLAN — NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Site plan at 1/16"=1'-0" scale. Shows new asphalt parking lot north of Building 2829. Eight (8) LED pole-mounted luminaires distributed across the lot: groups of 2 on west and east ends, and single poles along rows (L1-5 and L1-7 circuit designations). Conduit runs direct-buried (UG) to poles from Building 2829. Connection to existing panels L1 and R1 (SEC 1) inside Building 2829 (Electrical Room 117). Generator building and crushed storm structure visible at north edge of lot. Demolished rubble pile shown at east side. Construction notes reference: 1" direct-buried schedule 40 PVC conduit, (2) 20A/1P circuit breakers in existing Panel L1 (spaces 5, 7, and 9), lighting control panel connects to spare breaker in Panel R1 SEC 1 (space 27). Note: 1/16" scale makes individual space counts harder to verify from drawing alone — parking space striping visible but individual count not stated on this sheet.

sheets.title: DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Lighting Controls Diagram and Conduit Detail. LCP1 panel designation, located at Electrical Room 117. Power circuit R1 (SEC 1)-27. Two zones/relays: Relay 1 (L1-5, parking lot lights) and Relay 2 (L1-7, parking lot lights), both with photocell on/off and manual switch override control scenario. Photocell mounted on NEMA 3R junction box on Building 2829 roof. Conduit detail shows transition from underground PVC (direct buried) to galvanized rigid steel conduit (GRC) above grade with underground warning ribbon.

sheets.title: PANELBOARD SCHEDULES
sheets.reading_notes: Two existing panelboard schedules. Panel L1: 400A MCB, 480/277V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 22 KAIC min, surface mount. New circuits added: Parking Lot Lights Relay #1 (20A, circuit 5) and Parking Lot Lights Relay #2 (20A, circuit 7 — but also a space shown at circuit 9 per note on ES101). Panel R1 (SEC 1): 225A MCB, 208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 10 KAIC min, surface mount. New circuit: Lighting Control Panel (5A, circuit 27). Both panels located in Building 2829 Electrical Room 117. No new electrical service introduced — project taps existing building panels.
